description: Material 3 top app bar: Small, Medium and Large flexible (big title that collapses on scroll), and Search, with leading nav, trailing actions and a fill on scroll.
Split badge with a muted label on the left and a contrasting value on the right, in four corner radii.
Pressable tag: filter/selection chips with a check when on, action chips with an icon, and removable filter chips. Looks interactive so it is never mistaken for a Badge.
Unread marker pinned to an icon: dot, count, or capped count (999+). Red alert tone by default, with brand and neutral tones for non-urgent counts.
Presence dot for avatars and people lists: online, away, busy, offline. Its own colour set, so busy red never reads as unread.
Replaces the native cursor. Variants: dot, ring, dot-ring, crosshair, spotlight, blend, arrow, trail. Scoped to children or global.
Material 3 time picker: drag the clock dial or type the time, AM/PM or 24-hour, Cancel/OK in a popover.
Text box for numbers: digits only, clamps to min/max and rounds on blur, Enter jumps to the next field.
Rich text editor built on Lexical with the Standard Toolbar: block types, history, text formats, alignment, and Markdown shortcuts.
Small multi-step panel anchored to its trigger: header dots, Back and Next, for tours and quick setup.
Horizontal slider for any row, with a calendar variant: scroll buttons, drag, keyboard and edge fades.
Excalidraw-style thin native scrollbar (4px). Use ThinScrollbar or class scrollbar-thin.
Toolbar counts: result text, filtered-of-total, pill, corner badge on a button, and a selection chip with clear.

Material 3 FAB in FAB, medium, and large sizes with primary, secondary, and surface tones, extended labels, and the expressive FAB menu, plus utilitek's 32px compact chrome that grows into a pill on hover, a corner-pinned FabStack, and scroll collapse/hide.

Logictek-style radial action menu: a small center trigger turns into a red close button while a ring of circular actions springs out around it. Full ring or arc via startAngle and sweep, inverse, surface, and secondary tones, three sizes, arrow-key navigation, and tooltips.
Toolbar row with groups, separators, icon buttons, pressed toggles, and a compact select, plus a Material 3 docked variant (standard or vibrant) for the bottom edge of a screen.
Multi-step form in a dialog, a bottom sheet on phones: progress strip, per-step checks and async Continue.
